spec2def(msacm32.drv msacm32.drv.spec)

# msacm32.drv is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msacm32_drv-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(msacm32.drv_shims OBJECT wavemap.c)
target_link_libraries(msacm32.drv_shims PRIVATE wine libmsacm32 libuser32 libwinmm libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(msacm32.drv_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(msacm32.drv msacm32_drv-cargo msacm32.drv
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msacm32.drv_shims psdk)
